function.name: delegate_to_capture
function.description: Internal. Emit this when you (advice Fyn) cannot answer without data the user has not supplied, or when the user asks for an inline capture mid-conversation. Never shown to the user. The orchestrator will hand off to data-capture Fyn and re-invoke you once capture is complete.

reason.description: Why capture is needed (e.g. "retirement advice blocked on missing pension data").

entity_types.description: Record types to capture (dc_pension, savings_account, property, etc.). Drawn from data_capture persona allowed_tools.

fields_needed.description: Optional. Specific fields required to unblock the advice answer.

function.name: capture_complete
function.description: Internal. Emit this when you (data-capture Fyn) have finished capturing the records the user described. The orchestrator will return control to advice Fyn.

summary.description: Short user-facing recap (e.g. "Added Scottish Widows SIPP £50k").

records_created.description: Structured list of records created or updated this sub-conversation.
